Class CursorManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.client.ui.gui.CursorManager
public class CursorManager extends Object
Utility class that manages custom cursors across the GUI. Provides a base cursor for general navigation and a hover cursor that is automatically applied when the mouse moves over interactive elements such as cards, tiles, buttons, and text fields. Cursors are loaded lazily on first use and shared across the application.
